Shader Graphs/sg_distortion.note: Opaque-texture refraction offset by gradient noise or view-depth ripple (toggle _NoizeOrRipple); alpha = vertex alpha. Needs Opaque Texture.

Shader Graphs/sg_distortion_fade.note: sg_distortion with alpha = _Transparency. Needs Opaque Texture.

Shader Graphs/sg_explosion_sphere.note: Additive world triplanar texture x scrolled noise mask, smoothstep alpha edges, ColorOut/ColorIn HDR tint, vertex colour, silhouette fade.

Shader Graphs/sg_flame02_additive.note: Additive two-sided flame: two scrolled mask samples, uv fade, alpha clip 0.5, simple-noise vertex wobble along the normal.

Shader Graphs/sg_flame02_multiply.note: sg_flame02_additive graph in multiply blend: rgb = lerp(1, colour, alpha).

Shader Graphs/sg_fresnel_outline.note: Fresnel rim lerp(base, edge colour) with alpha = fresnel, plus emission image x colour x intensity.

Shader Graphs/sg_overlaid_fire.note: Additive object-space triplanar fire with hue-rotated position/normal over time, simple-noise mask, smoothstep alpha edges, ColorOut/ColorIn tint.

Shader Graphs/sg_shield.note: Colour shield: alpha = (|fresnel|^power + depth-intersection edge) x flickering overlaid scrolling hex texture. Needs Depth Texture.
